channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Iran: UK withdraws embassy staff amid growing threat of US air strikes
item.description: The Foreign Office has temporarily pulled out its staff from Iran amid a growing threat of US air strikes.

item.title: Anthropic: Why AI company is going head to head with the Pentagon
item.description: A major stand-off is unfolding between the Pentagon and the AI company Anthropic, as this evening's deadline looms over the future of the company’s $200m military contracts.

item.title: Anas Sarwar: Labour’s Scottish leader reacts after party’s by-election loss
item.description: It was no surprise that Sir Keir Starmer chose not to attend Scottish Labour’s conference today.

item.title: Former President Bill Clinton testifies over relationship with Jeffrey Epstein
item.description: Yesterday it was Hillary Clinton, and today it was her husband Bill's turn to testify in front of the House Oversight Committee about his relationship with Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Exclusive: Woman paralysed by violent ex urges more awareness of coercive control
item.description: Trudi Burgess' partner was charismatic, capable and much admired. But he was also a "manipulative, entitled" abuser.

item.title: Why Welsh Parliament elections could be another headache for Starmer
item.description: The Welsh Parliament elections in May could provide another headache for Sir Keir Starmer.

item.title: Gorton & Denton: Has Green Party’s historic by-election win changed British politics?
item.description: It was supposed to be a three-horse race and too close to call. But that's not how the Gorton and Denton by-election played out.

item.title: Andy Burnham: What next for Manchester Mayor blocked from standing in by-election
item.description: In the aftermath of the by-election result, our North of England correspondent Clare Fallon joined us from Manchester, where she had been trying to speak to Andy Burnham.

item.title: ‘They were right’ – Environment Secretary on decision to block Andy Burnham from standing in Gorton & Denton
item.description: Earlier we spoke to the Environment Secretary Emma Reynolds and asked here whether Manchester mayor Andy Burnham would have won the seat if he'd been allowed to stand for Labour.

item.title: Which way back for Labour after Gorton and Denton by-election loss?
item.description: The Green Party has won the formerly safe Labour seat of Gorton and Denton.
